note: Audited signature-SCHEME equivalence registrations (Round 16 safety hotfix). These entries NEVER rewrite history: every original ledger record keeps its legacy v1 signature, ci_run, deb sha256 and provenance exactly as built. Equivalence only states that the v2 semantic build-input fingerprint of the CURRENT tree provably matches the PINNED v2 fingerprint of the inputs that actually produced the v1-signed build; the engine re-verifies all pinned components (aligned version, recipe/host content hashes, v2 port-input hash) against fresh measurements on EVERY run — a stale or forged entry grants nothing when any component differs. Approved exclusively via human-reviewed PR; engine refuses malformed files (fail-closed).

migrations.approved_by: PR #6 (Automated Maintenance Safety Hotfix, human-reviewed merge)

port_toml_blob_changed.key_level_diff: ONLY [port].last_validated_* (promotion records) and [gates].device_gate / device_gate_history (device-gate result records). No contract key differs (verified key-by-key with tomllib: version/phase/policy_mode, [termux], [sandbox], [rules] r1-r9b, [gates] contracts, [forbidden] all identical).

equivalence_evidence.build_impact_proof: port.toml has no reader in the build chain: prepare_recipe.py copies it verbatim into the recipe BUILDER_DIR as an audit ledger (shutil.copy2); the generated port hook executes only chromium_sandbox_port.py + rule-count checks; ci.sh/gate scripts do not parse it; BUILDER_DIR contents are not packaged into the DEB. Excluding its audit records therefore cannot skip a build whose real inputs changed: any change to contract keys (or any byte of the four raw files) still moves the signature.
equivalence_evidence.raw_files_note: git blob ids (proof of byte-identity between build commit and main); the v2 hash uses sha256(file bytes)[:40] content fingerprints of these SAME bytes

migrations.port_inputs_formula: sha256("\n".join(["sigv2", fp(port/chromium_sandbox_port.py), fp(port/prepare_recipe.py), fp(port/gnp_shim.c), fp(port/ci.sh), "port.toml@semantic-v2:"+semantic_hash]) + "\n")[:16]; fp = sha256(file bytes)[:40]; semantic_hash = sha256("port-toml-v2:"+canonical_json)["..16"] over all keys EXCEPT the TOML_METADATA_ONLY audit denylist
